title: Sign in, register and account access | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Sign in, register and regain account access
hero.lead: This page covers every route from creating an account and signing in to recovering a locked account or forgotten password.

body:
Sign in

  1. Open Kaderblick and select Sign in.
  2. Enter your email address and password.
  3. Select Log in. The button cannot be selected again while the details are being checked.

Sign in with Google starts authentication through a Google account. Sign-in is completed after you return to Kaderblick.

On the demo instance, Show demo accounts opens prepared test accounts. This selection exists only in the demo.

Complete two-factor authentication

If two-factor authentication is enabled, Kaderblick requests an additional check after email and password:

  • Authenticator app: Enter the six-digit code from your app.
  • Email: Kaderblick sends the code automatically. Resend code requests a new one.
  • Backup code: Switch to backup-code entry if you cannot use a regular code.

Back to sign in leaves the code check and restarts sign-in.

Create an account

  1. Open the Register tab in the sign-in dialog.
  2. Enter your full name and email address.
  3. Choose a password of at least eight characters.
  4. Enter the same password under Confirm password. Different entries are marked immediately.
  5. Select Create account.

After registration, Kaderblick displays the address to which the confirmation email was sent. Open its link. The confirmation page then takes you to sign-in. A missing, invalid or expired confirmation link is reported on that page.

Reset a forgotten password

  1. Select Forgot password? in the sign-in dialog.
  2. Enter your account email and select Request link.
  3. Open the link in the email.
  4. Enter a new password of at least eight characters and repeat it in the confirmation field. The eye icon shows or hides the entry.
  5. Save the password. Kaderblick returns to sign-in after the change.

If the link is invalid or its code is missing, request a new link directly from the error page.

Unlock a locked account

  1. Open Unlock account through the notice shown during sign-in.
  2. Enter your email address.
  3. Select Request unlock link, then open the link in the email.

The destination page states whether unlocking succeeded. If the link is missing or invalid, request another unlock link there.

Sign out

  1. Open the user menu in the top-right corner using your name or account icon.
  2. Select Sign out.

The same menu also contains My profile, messages, your feedback, the registration QR code, the light/dark theme switch and cookie settings.
